terminal_reason.provider_constraint: RunPod containers share the provider host kernel, and the Pod creation interface does not expose a host-kernel selector. A fresh destination therefore cannot guarantee the frozen platform string.

operational_findings.mistake: Training and evaluation were separated across provider hosts while the evaluator required exact equality for a provider-controlled host-kernel string.
operational_findings.repair: Any recovery replication must train and evaluate on one uninterrupted destination.

operational_findings.mistake: Persistent storage was treated as sufficient continuity even though it preserves files, not the provider host kernel.
operational_findings.repair: Use persistent storage for artifacts and same-destination continuity for runtime identity.

operational_findings.mistake: Continuation controls were reconstructed manually after the original run and diverged from hashes and schemas embedded in the frozen admission program.
operational_findings.repair: Validate the complete authority chain locally before creating paid compute; do not hand-edit content-addressed controls.

operational_findings.mistake: A new exact-runtime destination was assumed discoverable even though the provider cannot select the required kernel.
operational_findings.repair: Do not spend on additional destination lotteries. Retrain under the frozen recipe and require byte-identical selected checkpoints before development can open.

decision: Close the original separated-host continuation as infrastructure-inconclusive. Preserve all H6 training evidence. Do not change the frozen evaluator and do not interpret this closeout as a model result.
